changes.summary: AFL Rosters on a phone: position headers span the full card again, and the sort chips scroll inside it and read like TheLeague's ("Pts ↓").
Quieter GroupMe: the Pecking Order and Gauntlet posts are now one line and a link, and trade rumors stay in the news feed and opt-in push alerts.
Franchise pages now follow each team through MFL renumbering: the SeaBirds keep their 2023–24 seasons, and no team shows another team’s old seasons.
Homepage My Team card shows this week in season: whether your lineup is set (and who's on bye or out), your record, next opponent, and one-tap Set Lineup, Free Agents, Trade Builder and Roster.
changes.headline: Your week, at the top of the homepage
changes.lede: The My Team card now tells you whether your lineup is set and flags any starter on bye or out, next to your record, your next opponent and shortcuts to the pages you use most.
changes.imageAlt: The My Team card: a green 'Week 5 lineup is set' line, tiles for record, next opponent, roster and cap space, and Set Lineup, Free Agents, Trade Builder and My Roster buttons

changes.summary: The menu now opens with the pages you use most — Roster, Set Lineup, Live Scoring, Free Agents, Standings, Trade Builder and Tip Schefter — pinned at the top all year.
